verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://developer.brex.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured table of contents for the Brex Developer API. Several docs pages are served as agent-friendly Markdown (.md) variants, including index.html.md, webhooks_api.md, mcp.md and postman.md, so an agent can be pointed directly at machine-readable docs. Missing for 10: visibility into the full depth and coverage of llms.txt (the probe output is truncated), independent or community hands-on corroboration of agents using these docs, and a raw OpenAPI spec at standard discovery paths (all returned 404).
